system.description:
HEALER

Your magic surges through your allies, restoring not just their health, but their energy and stamina as well.
Whenever you restore HP to a creature using a Healing spell, that creature gains a +1-status bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls for 1 round.
If the triggering spell requires 6 PP or more, this bonus increases to +2.
If the triggering spell requires 10 PP or more, the target also gains a +5-foot status bonus to Speed for 1 round.

Prerequisites Medicine 4 ranks

Use after a Healing spell (target the creature, enter the PP): +1 status to attacks and damage (+2 at 6 PP; +5 ft Speed at 10 PP) lands as a one-round effect.
